Sports Nutrition

The Brief

A PROTEIN BRAND
BUILT ON CHARACTER

The challenge was to create a bold, personality-driven sports nutrition brand from scratch — one that stands out on shelf and builds instant recognition across multiple product SKUs.

Challenge

Design a complete brand system for a whey protein line covering 5 flavors — each with a distinct color world while maintaining a unified brand identity through a mascot character.

Solution

A powerful 3D mascot character — The American GUY — acts as the brand anchor across all SKUs. Each flavor gets its own color system, background world, and ingredient visual language while sharing the same typographic and structural identity.

The Inspiration

FROM REAL MAN
TO BRAND ICON

The American GUY character is directly inspired by Saudi influencer and content creator Shadi Al-Amriki — known for his powerful presence, distinctive silver beard, and larger-than-life personality. The mascot translates his real identity into a 3D brand character that carries the same energy, confidence, and authenticity across every SKU.

The Real Person SHADI AL-AMRIKI
The Brand Character THE AMERICAN GUY

Process

HOW IT
CAME TOGETHER

Logo & Typography

Built a bold, condensed typographic identity — instantly recognizable and scalable across all touchpoints from label to merchandise.

Character Design

Designed and rendered The American GUY in 3D — front, side, and three-quarter views — adapted per flavor with matching outfit colors and ingredient props.

Label System

Built a modular label system with full supplement facts, flavor-specific color worlds, and consistent brand architecture across all SKUs.
